_about: Words the web page and the TUI both show. Each side has a test that holds its own copy to this file.
kill_confirm: Stop fine? Enter stops it, Esc keeps it.
clear_all_confirm_2: Forget 2 ended agents? Enter forgets them, Esc keeps them.
clear_all_confirm_1: Forget 1 ended agent? Enter forgets it, Esc keeps it.
blocked_by_gate: Blocked. The gate gave no detail.
blocked_own_question: Waiting on the agent's own question. Open it to answer.
